## Business programme and Buenos Aires

Buenos Aires combines a major business city with a rich cultural programme. Alongside the congress, you can explore the capital's distinctive neighbourhoods, restaurants and tango, combining work with an introduction to Argentina.

The architecture of the centre reflects European influences, while city life is closely tied to tango. The programme also takes in the theatres of Avenida Corrientes, urban art and the green parks of Palermo, offering a quieter break among the capital's dense buildings. The city tour runs from Plaza de Mayo and its historic buildings through San Telmo, the colourful façades of Caminito in La Boca, Recoleta and the modern waterfront of Puerto Madero. A tango show is planned for the evening.

Buenos Aires offers conference centres, hotels, transport connections and options for incentive programmes. Leisure options include private tango shows, food experiences and wine tours. In this programme, the group heads outside the capital after the business meetings: a trip to Tigre adds a private boat ride, islands and the quiet waterways of the Paraná Delta.
